overall_goal: Cover the marinated chicken with cling film and place it in the fridge

goals.description: Retrieve and unroll the cling film
goals.rationale: The person gets the cling film from the drawer, opens the box, and unrolls the film to prepare for covering the bowl.

goals.description: Cover and seal the bowl with cling film
goals.rationale: The person places the unrolled cling film over the bowl, tears it from the roll, and seals the edges to make it airtight.

goals.description: Place the covered bowl in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person carries the bowl to the fridge, temporarily sets it down to open the door, and then places it on the shelf.
